title: Signature Sky-Riding
body:
Signature Sky-Riding is the Signature edition's flight power: a Signature traveler rises, hovers, steers, and lands without machine, described as riding the air the way a swimmer rides water, with the Signature framing that the air itself is a road.

Signature fictional basis: an original Signature heroic trait, built to mirror public flight without copying any one character's version. Real-world science parallels: none for unaided human flight; the Signature edition states this plainly and keeps its Sky-Riders in fiction, where the cost is exposure, cold, and the need to land safely, and the limit is weather and altitude, as with any flight power.

Classification: flight. This power is fictional unless a real-world parallel is stated above; no claim is made that any person possesses it.

Status: fictional power; real-world parallels stated in record only where they exist.
